# Julia

> Julia is a high-level, high-performance, dynamic programming language for technical computing. It is open source (MIT license), compiles to efficient native code via LLVM, uses multiple dispatch as its core paradigm, and is widely used for scientific computing, numerical analysis, data science, machine learning, and simulation.

Key facts:

- Current stable release: Julia {{stable_release}} (released {{stable_release_date}}). Download: https://julialang.org/downloads/
- Current long-term support (LTS) release: Julia {{lts_release}} (released {{lts_release_date}}).
- Recommended installation is via Juliaup, the official Julia version manager. On macOS and Linux: `curl -fsSL https://install.julialang.org | sh`. On Windows: `winget install --name Julia --id 9NJNWW8PVKMN -e -s msstore`. Then run `julia` to start, and `juliaup --help` to manage installed versions.
- License: MIT. Source code: https://github.com/JuliaLang/julia
- Official documentation: https://docs.julialang.org
- Packages are installed with the built-in package manager (`using Pkg; Pkg.add("Name")`, or `]add Name` in the REPL) from the General registry. Discover packages at https://juliahub.com/ui/Packages
- Community: Discourse (https://discourse.julialang.org) for questions, plus Slack, Zulip and Discord for chat.

## Docs

- [Julia Documentation](https://docs.julialang.org/en/v1/): The official manual, Base and standard library reference for the current stable release
- [Getting Started](https://docs.julialang.org/en/v1/manual/getting-started/): First steps with the Julia REPL
- [Performance Tips](https://docs.julialang.org/en/v1/manual/performance-tips/): How to write fast Julia code
- [Noteworthy Differences from other Languages](https://docs.julialang.org/en/v1/manual/noteworthy-differences/): Differences from MATLAB, R, Python, C/C++ and Common Lisp
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://docs.julialang.org/en/v1/manual/faq/): Common questions about the language
- [Pkg documentation](https://pkgdocs.julialang.org/v1/): The Julia package manager

- [Supported platforms](https://julialang.org/downloads/support/): Platform support tiers and release support status
